sections.title: Batch 5 — Listen, Speak, See: audio help, voice typing and picture choices (14–16 Nov 2026)
points: Listen (🔊): a Listen button under every box of the worker and customer screens says what to do there, and the same help opens in large text. The sound comes from a clip the team recorded, else a voice on the device, else the help is shown on screen with the words "no voice on this device" (D-034). Roman Urdu users hear the Urdu audio.

Speak (🎤): voice typing on names, city, trade, job, search, skills description and numbers (phone digit by digit, years and rupees as amounts; nothing is written when a number is not understood). Never on password, CNIC or email (D-035). A one-time notice explains that the browser sends the voice to its maker's service. After voice typing the website reads back what it wrote, and Undo brings the old text back.

See: picture choices instead of drop-downs for trade (the nine trade drawings), availability, the skill of a proof photo and the proof kind; every picture can be heard; field icons; buttons with an icon and a word.
Page help: a round speaker button in the same corner of every in-scope page, and a Sound menu in the header (show Listen/Speak, read aloud by itself). Settings stay on this device only.
Language chooser: each language card can be heard ("press here for Urdu"), and the one-time question "Should the website read aloud?" follows the choice.
Voice check page (/voice-check, linked from the Help Centre): which voices and clips this device has, test sentences, a microphone test, and how to add an Urdu voice on Android.

Recorded clips: /dev/recorder (development builds only) for the team to record the Urdu help in their own voices; npm run audio:manifest; docs/audio/RECORDING-GUIDE.md. The service worker (v2) keeps clips for offline use; API answers are still never cached. No clips are recorded yet.
Texts: 152 new or changed texts in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu are drafts until the team checks them (docs/i18n/REVIEW-BATCH-5.md, D-031).

sections.title: Go-live kit and cleanup (11 Nov 2026)
points: Wordmark: "Digital Labour Marketplace" is one element, weight 700, in the logo's colour, the full name at every width (before: two weights, the second word grey and hidden on phones).

Internal working notes (CLAUDE.md, the batch briefs, docs/audit/) are no longer tracked (kept on disk, in .gitignore); every reference now points to a tracked document. docs/SECURITY.md lists the project security rules.

Go-live (D-032, docs/DEPLOY-RUNBOOK.md): backend/api/index.js as the one Vercel function, a modern backend/vercel.json (no legacy builds; only public/ served), frontend/vercel.json passes /api/:path* to the backend before the app fallback; production settings check (missing variable, local database, non-https origin, missing TRUST_PROXY -> the server refuses to start); optional SHOW_CLIENT_IP check; npm run db:indexes; scripts/atlas-create-admin.sh (first admin from Ubuntu in a throwaway node:24-bookworm container, secrets from a file outside the repository).

sections.title: Mid-defence preparation (11 Nov 2026, feature freeze: bug fixes only)
points: bash scripts/preview.sh start | demo | reset-demo | status | stop: one command for the whole local preview (MongoDB, API, website) in the dev container; demo uses a separate database dlm_demo.

npm run demo:reset (backend): wipes only a local _demo database and creates the three synthetic demo accounts (the admin through the create-admin script). The normal preview database is never touched.
Decisions D-030 (MERN on the supervisor's instruction) and D-031 (Urdu and Roman Urdu texts reviewed by the team), both reported on 11 Nov 2026.
docs/DEMO-SCRIPT.md: the 7-minute demo of Modules 1-3, with a drawn synthetic proof photo (docs/demo/work-photo-synthetic.jpg) and frontend/e2e/demo-script.e2e.js, which runs the same clicks.
Bug fixed (found by rehearsing the demo): onboarding Step 4 offered no skill for the proof photo until the page was reloaded. Test: onboarding.test.jsx (fails without the fix) and the demo e2e test.
Real results: backend 521/521, frontend 941/941, e2e 35/35 (12.6 min, Chromium), oxlint 0.
